article: Qiskitを使った量子プログラミング超入門
scope: Rewrote the Japanese article and twelve translations. Checked quantum-state mathematics, measurement, superposition versus readout, no-signalling in entanglement, current Qiskit packaging and AerSimulator code, ideal-simulation interpretation, query-complexity conditions, and official links.
findings: Removed claims that n-qubit superposition itself gives general exponential parallel speedup; clarified that measurement does not expose all amplitudes.
Corrected entanglement explanation: Bell-state outcomes are correlated but cannot transmit information faster than light.
Qualified quantum-computing applications and Deutsch–Jozsa/Grover speedups by their problem and oracle assumptions.
Replaced outdated Qiskit/Aer references and code with Qiskit 1.x plus separately installed qiskit-aer and AerSimulator.
Distinguished ideal local simulation from noisy hardware results and documented sampling variation and bit-order caveat.

post/Qiskit入門/index.en.md.summary: Rewrote and aligned this translation with the corrected Qiskit and quantum-computing explanations.

meaning.note: Aligned the explanation of state amplitudes, measurement, gates, Bell-state correlations, and algorithm assumptions with the reviewed source and IBM references.

terminology.note: Checked qubit, computational basis, unitary gate, entanglement, Aer simulator, oracle, and query-complexity terms.

mathematics.note: Verified amplitude normalization and outcome probabilities; the Bell-state circuit and ideal counts; and the conditional query-complexity statements for Deutsch–Jozsa and Grover.

code.note: Updated to the Qiskit 1.x separate qiskit-aer package and AerSimulator API. Code was statically reviewed; Qiskit and qiskit-aer are not installed in this workspace, so it was not executed here.

links.note: Replaced archived qiskit.org links with current official IBM Quantum installation, local-simulator, migration, QuantumCircuit, and AerSimulator documentation.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The sample targets current Qiskit 1.x APIs but was not executed because Qiskit packages are absent in this workspace.
Quantum algorithm speedups are stated only in the specified query/oracle model; no claim of general practical speedup is made.
